basis.owner_request: Develop each of the 27 blocked fixture alpha records as a distinct strategy hypothesis, implement candidates, and evaluate them by backtest.

scope.candidate_budget: one pre-registered candidate per parent alpha for this initial research batch
scope.candidate_identity: Research proposals for fixture records; not recovered author intent and not edits to user-owned source records.
scope.evaluation: Use the existing three development folds and admission gates; all available historical data has already been viewed, so no result is an untouched holdout.
scope.resource_limit: Keep the existing EDU limit of 2 GB per job and run jobs serially.

prohibitions: Do not modify or promote any original alpha record.
Do not add parameter sweeps or repeated variants to force a positive result.
Do not claim profitability, robustness, live readiness, or future performance without the required evidence.
Do not start a live or testnet bot as part of this backtest batch.
